speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (Unstable Angina) with incidental, misinterpreted findings of Guillain-Barré syndrome. The confirmed ST-segment depression, exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw/left arm, diaphoresis, smoking history, and hypertension are diagnostic for cardiac ischemia. The GBS finding is likely a false positive or unrelated; the immediate priority is treating the heart attack.
